name: Surefire Test Report
description: Report Surefire test results as annotations on Github Pull Requests and Workflows [junit, failsafe]

report_paths.description: surefire/failsafe/junit compatible xml report paths in glob format

report_mode.description: report publishing mode: auto keeps check runs for PR/push flows and uses workflow annotations for workflow_dispatch/schedule; set check-run or workflow to overr

create_check.description: create a new check with annotations when report_mode resolves to check-run

commit.description: commit sha to update the status

fail_on_test_failures.description: fail run if there were test failures

fail_if_no_tests.description: fail run if there were no test results found

github_base_url.description: if you use Github Enterprise, you can set this to the URL of your server (e.g. https://github.myorg.com/api/v3)

custom_summary.description: optional custom summary text to display in the published check output
